string.text: Now we can talk.
Hey you, stop!
You're on your own from here - we're not going in there with you, our orders are to hold this area.
Where are you going, stalker?
Hey, he's shooting at our rats!
Oh, hey! Come on over and talk to me.
Come in, let's talk. You'll find me at our base. I'm waiting.
Uh, I don't get it, is he fucking dead?! Get over here!
Hey, you! Meet me in the building next to the water tower, we need to talk.
Bro, come out! Come down.

Attention, everyone! A bounty has been placed on the head of the fucker named Messer! He's been attacking neutrals unprovoked and already killed several people! Let this be a warning - if anyone else tries that shit, you'll end up the same! Still... if the coward manages to drag his sorry ass here, maybe I'll help him atone for his sins...
What the fuck are you doing?! Kill another neutral stalker and you'll be hunted like a blind dog, so watch your ass!
Hey, are you out of your mind?! These are my guys, and they're guarding my bunker! You'll stop harming my men if you know what's good for ya!

Messer, what the fuck?! I specifically told you to go save him, and now he's dead! You still got amnesia, or are you normally this useless?! What the hell am I supposed to say when the military comes kicking down my door?! Get back over here, now!
Attention! Critical radiation levels detected! Check the suit for leaks or leave the contaminated area immediately!
Thanks for your help. I need to be alone.
Stalker, come over here, I got something to discuss. I'm by the slope of the mountain.
Great, look towards the road to the Bar. After the helicopter crosses paths with you, head towards the bunker.
What's going on with the group? Damn it, Messer...
Yes, it seems to be him.
I want to ask you about...

Stalker, you've heard of the Bar, right? A lively spot in the heart of the Zone where stalkers everywhere gather for food and drink after raids. Word is, they're pretty impressed with your work, but the Barkeep wont speak to you empty-handed. He's shown interest in some documents. A little birdie told me you can find them in a house in the Dark Valley. Better hurry over there before someone beats you to them!

This loot will be your golden ticket into the elite club. With it, most stalkers in the zone will finally consider you experienced. However... you still can't get into the Valley. And it's not because of your gear - quite the opposite, actually. There's some kind of mysterious installation there pumping out maddening psi waves...

You need a special psi blocker. I have some intel that suggests a small group of soldiers made it out to the Garbage recently, and it looks like they all met an untimely death. If my intel is correct, one of them should have a psi blocker. They were last seen at the flooded road crossing, maybe start there.
Stalker, watch out! That's a pseudo-dog!
Wait, don't go! Messer!
Well, here we are. Make yourself comfortable. Remember, the doors are locked from the inside, not out. Get some shut-eye. When you're ready, we'll shoot over to the Bar for a few drinks and a chat.
You awake? Great. Hope the rest did you some good. Let's to head over to the Bar.
Hey, Messer! Wait.

Hey bro, come here! We found that bandit bastard that smoked seven of our guys a couple days ago. The fucker's holed up in the house up on the hill. Come with us and help us show that scum a true beating!
Where's my gun, Messer?! Are you really planning on keeping it for yourself? I'll remember this, Messer!

Messer, come in! Listen, I need you to grab an artifact for me. It's called the "Toad's Eye". It's located in the Garbage, up north. I sent a group there recently, but I lost contact with them as soon as they reached the coordinates. One of my defectors said there were no anomalies in the area where they saw the artifact, but the cowards still refused to retrieve the damned thing. So hightail it to the Garbage and get me that artifact. I've uploaded the coordinates to your PDA.

Yeah, one more thing. That thing you shot stole one of my courier's documents while he was sleeping in the factory. He said it had some kind of lair on the upper level of the building under the roof. Maybe the creature took them there. Find them and bring them to me. They have some value, so don't come back without them.
I don't get it, is he dead or something? What the hell were you looking at? I sent you to him. Let's go back to my bunker.

Oh, I almost forgot. Your PDA has the ability to display the contacts of stalkers that are within a radius of about 250 meters from you, and you can use it to contact some of them from a distance. To do this, select the desired stalker in the contacts section. There you can also see a brief description of this stalker. Try to reach Digger via PDA when you are near him. I think you'll get the gist of it...
Yeah, one more thing... Your PDA has a battery that discharges over time. Keep an eye on the battery life so you don't get stranded without it at the worst possible moment!
How are you doing, still alive?

Messer, there's something going on at the checkpoint. Ever since that emission, I can't get any signals from there... it's like there's nobody there. Listen, why don't you run over there and see what's going on? If you do, make sure to get the hell out of there quickly. Let me know what you see.
Hey, man, come here. Help us deal with the pack, then we'll talk...
How you feeling, rookie?
He's doing great! And he's no rookie either, if you'd seen the way he deftly took down the ringleader...
Yes... he's no newbie. Come, we need to talk.
Watch out! There's a pseudo-dog! Somebody kill it! Hurry up! Stalker, get it off!
Fighters, take your positions! The dead are coming. Messer, this is your chance to make your mark.
Chin up, men! Another wave is coming!
Attention all! We are detecting strange interference in the air, everyone be careful...
Okay, we've got the rat, all right... he's pushing our ammo to the left. Go to our merchant for the reward.
Ah... critters...
Damn it. I knew there was something fishy about this place. Okay, let's go find another place...

Sergei... The group is dead... everyone... fucking bloodsuckers! Damn it...! What to do now... Thanks for coming with me, stalker. I owe you one. If you need me, you can catch me where I was or at the Bar. I need a drink.
Fucking door.

I've got a special order here. Bring anything weird you find. You never know what kind of surprise the Zone will spring on you next time. It's ten times the price for an unknown artifact. And hurry, you're not alone

Hey, are you outside the Cordon now? I was told a strange artifact was seen in that area. Bring anything strange you find. You never know what kind of surprise the Zone will give you next time. There's a tenfold fee for this unknown artifact. And hurry, you're not the only one looking for it.
There's information about a special artifact in the area where you are. Bring anything weird you find. You never know what surprise the Zone will give you next time.
Hmm, looks like a source of the contagion...
Hmm, looks like a source of the contagion...
Messer, this is the leader of the Duty faction. I'm waiting for you at my place, we need to talk.
Hello, Rat, trying to do your business behind my back?
Hello, Major. I was acting solely on your instructions.
Leave us two alone.
Do I have to repeat myself?
Shit, there's someone out there, everyone be on the lookout!
Everyone group up! The tunnel leading to Rostok is now our top priority. Let's move out!
Okay, it's quiet. Come stalker, we'll discuss what's next...
Keep quiet... Everyone check your guns...
There's something there...
Halt! Let's take the bastards down! Whoa... who are these guys?
Okay, put the guns away, guys. This is just an ID check. You try to run, you're gonna get shot, I'm warning you.
What the hell?! Nail, go check it out. We're holding these ones, don't piss--
There's nothing here! Let's go get these guys and get the fuck outta here!
You! Take your backpack off!
Fuck! Get the fuck away!
Messer! Get out of here, let's go!
Messer! Follow me, let's get out of here, hurry up! What the hell is this place!? That thing dragged you down here before I could get here!
It's quiet. Shit. Go to the Bar and talk to the Barkeep about what happened. I'm not going with you, I have some things I need to take care of... Go!
I think I got a signal. Wait a bit, our guys will give them a warm welcome. If you can, do us a favor and help our guys. They wont know what hit them in the dark!
Quiet down, boys. Let's try to get in silently...
Stalker, get out of here... This does not concern you.
Hey, stalker! Come here, bro! I have something to do!
This password expired on 20.02.2012. Please enter a new password.
Fuck... Fucking Slug...
Uh, hey you. Yeah, you! Come over here, around the corner.
Messer, turn on your PDA and check the Contacts tab. You'll find me there. I'll fill you in on the situation...
Connection lost.
Hey, have you completely lost your fucking mind?! If anyone else dies because of you, there will be a large bounty placed on your head! You will not survive a single minute in the zone!
Unknown sniper
